checks.command:
tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-claim.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -r "$tmp"' EXIT; (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); mkdir -p "$tmp/repo/_beads" "$tmp/repo/sub" "$tmp/bin"; git -C "$tmp/repo" init -q; printf '%s
' '#!/usr/bin/env bash' 'printf "%s
" "$*" >"$TRACE_FILE"' 'printf "claimed-output
"' >"$tmp/bin/br"; chmod +x "$tmp/bin/br"; (cd "$tmp/repo" && PATH="$tmp/bin:$PATH" BEADS_DIR="$tmp/repo/_beads" TRACE_FILE="$tmp/trace" "$tmp/ao" claim age-1 >"$tmp/claim.out"); grep -qx 'update age-1 --claim' "$tmp/trace"; grep -qx 'claimed-output' "$tmp/claim.out"; (cd "$tmp/repo" && "$tmp/ao" claim >"$tmp/help" && "$tmp/ao" claim check --help >"$tmp/check-help"); (cd "$tmp/repo/sub" && "$tmp/ao" claim bind --claim AOP-X --path p.md --level PG2 >"$tmp/bind.out"); (cd "$tmp/repo" && "$tmp/ao" claim list >"$tmp/list.out"); grep -q 'Claim a BR bead for harness-neutral AgentOps loops' "$tmp/help"; grep -q 'Report read-only proof cards for changed public claim markers' "$tmp/check-help"; grep -qx 'bound claim="AOP-X" path="p.md" level=PG2' "$tmp/bind.out"; jq -e '.Claim == "AOP-X" and .Path == "p.md" and .Level == "PG2"' "$tmp/list.out" >/dev/null; set +e; (cd "$tmp/repo" && "$tmp/ao" claim check --changed >"$tmp/check.out" 2>"$tmp/check.err"); check_code=$?; "$tmp/ao" claim one two >"$tmp/rejected.out" 2>"$tmp/rejected.err"; code=$?; set -e; test "$check_code" -eq 1; grep -q 'Error: claim check: claim proof: read claim registry:' "$tmp/check.err"; test "$code" -eq 1; test ! -s "$tmp/rejected.out"; grep -qx 'Error: accepts between 0 and 1 arg(s), received 2' "$tmp/rejected.err"

aliases.reason: The ao claim command family declares no aliases.
